title: XTEND AI Robotics, Inc. Completes Delivery Under $2.8 Million Defense Contract in Asia-Pacific

body_markdown:
**Contract completed through XTEND’s Asia-Pacific manufacturing operations, followed by customer audits, production testing and acceptance procedures**


TAMPA, Fla.--(


[BUSINESS WIRE](https://www.businesswire.com/) )--XTEND AI Robotics, Inc. (NYSE: XTND) (“XTEND” or the “Company”), a leader in software systems and Physical AI, today announced that its Asia-Pacific subsidiary, Performance Rotors Pte Ltd, successfully completed delivery under a defense contract valued at approximately $2.8 million with a customer in the region. Deliveries were completed in September 2026. The contract is included in the previously provided preliminary, unaudited revenue range of approximately $24.5 to $26.5 million through September 30, 2026.


The contract included 88 unmanned aerial systems, 84 ground control stations and integrated logistics support. The systems are compact, collision-tolerant unmanned aerial platforms designed for rapid deployment in complex urban environments. They were supplied in portable field kits with encrypted communications and software-configured capabilities, and were manufactured at Performance Rotors’ production facilities, part of XTEND’s regional XFAB manufacturing network.


“We are pleased to have successfully completed delivery of this order. Meeting a defense customer’s requirements and quality processes is what matters, and our team in the region delivered on both,” said Aviv Shapira, Co-Founder and CEO of XTEND.


The Asia-Pacific operations form part of XTEND’s global XFAB manufacturing network, designed to support regional production, customer requirements and the scalable delivery of robotic systems across international markets.

**About XTEND AI Robotics, Inc.**


XTEND is a leader in software systems and Physical AI, deployed in high-threat, complex operational environments where human exposure carries significant risk. Powered by its proprietary XTEND Operating System (XOS), XTEND’s integrated software and advanced robotic hardware solutions are designed to provide autonomy at the edge. Operating across Defense, Homeland Security, and Commercial Security missions through a platform of robots, drones, and robotic subsystems, XTEND’s open architecture platform facilitates scalability across partners and third-party applications. With over 12,500 systems deployed in over 30 countries, XTEND’s solutions have been validated in five combat zones and operationally deployed by national defense, special-mission units, and security organizations across the globe. Founded in Tel Aviv, Israel, and headquartered in Tampa, Florida, XTEND delivers NDAA-compliant solutions through a global network of regional XFAB manufacturing facilities located in the U.S., the U.K., Singapore, Israel, Mexico and Latvia.
